globals.name: current_program
globals.doc: The program the script runs on (revkit.Program: every SDK read and write).

globals.name: current_address
globals.doc: The cursor's address (int), or None.

globals.name: current_function
globals.doc: The function containing current_address (listing_pb2.Function), or None.

globals.name: current_selection
globals.doc: The selection as (first, last), or None.

globals.name: args
globals.doc: The script's arguments (--arg NAME=VALUE), typed by its @arg lines.

globals.name: script
globals.doc: The script's metadata (ScriptMeta: name, description, args, sha12).

globals.name: run_id
globals.doc: The run's id: its provenance session.

globals.name: client
globals.doc: The revkit.Client the run talks to the daemon with.

globals.name: monitor
globals.doc: Progress and cancellation: set_max, increment, message, check_cancelled.

globals.name: current_project
globals.doc: The program's project id.

globals.name: functions
globals.doc: Every function (``listing_pb2.Function``), in address order.

globals.name: function_at
globals.doc: The function starting at ``addr``, or None.

globals.name: function_containing
globals.doc: The function whose body holds ``addr``, or None.

globals.name: decompile
globals.doc: A function's decompilation (``.text``, ``.lines``, ``.variables``).

globals.name: decompile_many
globals.doc: Decompiles many functions (None: all) on the daemon's workers, yielding results as they complete (see Program.decompile_many).

globals.name: read_bytes
globals.doc: Initialized bytes at ``addr`` (fewer at the end of initialized memory).

globals.name: find_bytes
globals.doc: Addresses of ``pattern`` ("48 8b ?? 05", or bytes and a mask).

globals.name: search_memory
globals.doc: Ghidra's Search Memory on the daemon: ``query`` as hex ("48 8b ?? e8"), or ``format="string"``, "decimal", "float", "double", "binary", "regex" (``Program.search_memory`` has every option). The run's monitor cancels it. Matches have ``.address``, ``.bytes``, ``.label``, ``.preview``.

globals.name: search_text
globals.doc: Ghidra's Search Program Text: what the listing shows (``fields``: comments, labels, functions, mnemonics, operands, data_mnemonics, data_values), plain or ``regex=True``. Matches have ``.address``, ``.field``, ``.text``, ``.match_start``, ``.match_length``.

globals.name: search_scalars
globals.doc: Instructions and data using a constant: ``search_scalars(value=0x1000)`` or a range ``search_scalars(0, 0xff)``. Matches have ``.address``, ``.value``, ``.text``, ``.operand_index``.

globals.name: search_decompiled
globals.doc: Decompiled C of every function (or ``functions``) searched on the daemon's decompiler workers, with the monitor's progress. Matches have ``.function``, ``.function_name``, ``.line``, ``.text``.

globals.name: strings
globals.doc: The program's strings (``.address``, ``.value``, ``.xref_to_count``).

globals.name: instructions
globals.doc: Instructions with p-code in a range or a function's body.

globals.name: symbol_at
globals.doc: The effective name at ``addr`` ("" if none).

globals.name: to_addr
globals.doc: An address from an int, "0x401000", "401000h" or a symbol's name.

globals.name: export_type_archive
globals.doc: The program's types as a type archive (a C header and a JSON sidecar of hashes, categories and the data model): ``keys`` ("struct hdr"), a ``category`` and below, or ``scope`` "user" (the default: made, edited or imported in revkit) or "all". With ``directory`` both files are written there. Returns the response (``.header``, ``.sidecar``, ``.notes``).

globals.name: type_categories
globals.doc: Every category the program files a named type under: path -> how many types are directly in it ("/": those with none).

globals.name: equates
globals.doc: The equates table as committed: {name: Equate(name, value, references, ...)} (edits still buffered aren't in it).

globals.name: enums_with_value
globals.doc: Enums with a member of this value, the program's first.

globals.name: mangled_name
globals.doc: The mangled symbol the name at ``addr`` was demangled from ("" when the name isn't a demangled one; docs/demangle.md).

globals.name: demangled_signature
globals.doc: The demangler's whole output for the name at ``addr``, parameters included ("geo::Shape::scale(double)"); "" when it isn't demangled.

globals.name: image_base
globals.doc: Where the program's image is now (its lowest loaded address).

globals.name: preview
globals.doc: What is at ``addr``, as the UI's hover card previews it (docs/ui.md "Hover cards"): a function's ``signature`` and first ``lines`` of C, else the listing's rows there (``kind`` "function" or "data"; ``name``).

globals.name: set_image_base
globals.doc: Moves the program to a new image base, with everything recorded about it (docs/memory-map.md, "Rebase"). Not buffered: it commits at once (the program reloads at the new base), and edits buffered before it are committed first.

globals.name: rename
globals.doc: Names a function, label or global.

globals.name: rename_local
globals.doc: Names a local variable by its storage key (``Decompile`` variables).

globals.name: retype
globals.doc: Types a global or gives a function its prototype (a C declaration).

globals.name: comment
globals.doc: A comment: eol, pre, post, plate, repeatable or decompiler; "" deletes.

globals.name: set_function
globals.doc: Declares a function at ``entry`` (``body``: inclusive ranges; empty: discovered).

globals.name: flow_override
globals.doc: none, branch, call, call_return or return.

globals.name: note
globals.doc: A note (a tagged annotation that is not a comment).

globals.name: define_type
globals.doc: Parses C declarations for the program and defines their types (binding their names) with the run's edits. Returns the names it will define ("struct point"); retype with them after ``commit()``.

globals.name: define_data
globals.signature: define_data(addr, type=None, *, count=0, string=None, layout=None, collapsed=None, type_hash=None)
globals.doc: Defines data at ``addr``: ``type`` (C such as "uint32_t" or "struct hdr", or a builtin name such as "dword"; or ``type_hash``), an array of ``count`` of them, or a string (``string`` "utf8", "utf16" or "utf32"; ``layout`` "terminated", "fixed" (``count`` characters), "pascal" or "pascal16").

globals.name: clear
globals.doc: Clears [addr, addr + length) back to undefined bytes (Ghidra's Clear Code Bytes).

globals.name: disassemble
globals.doc: Disassembles from ``addr`` (``isa``: None, "arm" or "thumb"); ``function=True`` also makes it a function.

globals.name: set_mutability
globals.doc: Marks [addr, addr + length) "constant", "volatile", "normal" or "default".

globals.name: auto_create_structure
globals.doc: Ghidra's Auto Create Structure: a structure from how the variable (``storage_key`` from ``decompile``) is used as a pointer, here and ``call_depth`` calls deep (default 1), defined and bound by name, and the variable retyped to a pointer to it. Returns the structure's name.

globals.name: auto_fill_structure
globals.doc: Ghidra's Auto Fill in Structure: fields added to the structure the variable points to where its use shows some and it has none. Returns the structure's name.

globals.name: create_structure
globals.doc: Create Structure from a selection: a structure of the data defined in [first, last] (undefined filler elsewhere), defined at ``first``. Returns its name.

globals.name: import_type_archive
globals.doc: Imports a type archive (``<name>.h`` and, beside it unless given, ``<name>.json``) with the run's edits: checked against the sidecar's hashes, its types defined and bound where the program lacks them, filed under its categories. Returns the names it defines or rebinds.

globals.name: set_type_category
globals.doc: Files named types ("struct hdr", or a list of them) under a category ("/net/http"; "/" the top).

globals.name: move_types_to_project
globals.doc: Moves named types ("struct hdr", or a list) to project scope, where every program of the project sees them (now, not with the run's edits). Returns the keys moved.

globals.name: copy_types_to_program
globals.doc: Copies project types into this program (now): its copy then wins over the project's. Returns the keys copied.

globals.name: type_archives
globals.doc: The type archives of the program's project: [{"name", "kind", "enabled", "applies", "functions", "types"}].

globals.name: set_type_archive_enabled
globals.doc: Turns a type archive ("libc-lp64", "ghidra", an attached one) on or off for every program of the project, with the run's edits.

globals.name: convert
globals.signature: convert(addr, value, format, *, operand=None, apply_to=None, constant_hash=0)
globals.doc: Shows the scalar ``value`` at the instruction ``addr`` as Ghidra's Convert does: "hex", "signed", "unsigned", "octal", "binary", "char", "float" ("default": as the disassembler prints it).

globals.name: set_equate
globals.signature: set_equate(addr, value, name, *, operand=None, apply_to=None, constant_hash=0)
globals.doc: Shows the scalar ``value`` at the instruction ``addr`` as ``name`` (Set Equate); ``apply_to`` "function" or "program" names every operand holding the value there too.

globals.name: set_enum_equate
globals.signature: set_enum_equate(addr, value, enum, member, *, operand=None, apply_to=None, constant_hash=0)
globals.doc: Shows the scalar as an enum's member (``enum`` by name or type hash).

globals.name: clear_display
globals.doc: The scalar shows as the disassembler prints it again (a conversion or an equate cleared).

globals.name: rename_equate
globals.doc: Renames an equate at every operand that shows it (as committed).

globals.name: remove_equate
globals.doc: Removes an equate everywhere (as committed): its operands show the disassembler's text again.

globals.name: add_reference
globals.doc: Adds a reference from the instruction at ``from_`` to ``to``: "data", "read", "write", "call", "jump", "computed_call" or "computed_jump", on ``operand`` (None: the instruction as a whole).

globals.name: remove_reference
globals.doc: Deletes the references from ``from_`` to ``to``: the user's (as committed) and analysis's.

globals.name: set_primary_reference
globals.doc: Makes the (committed) reference from ``from_`` to ``to`` its operand's primary one, or not.

globals.name: commit
globals.doc: Commits the buffered edits now (one revision); None when there are none.

globals.name: revert
globals.doc: Undoes a run's committed edits in one revision (default: this run's).

globals.name: pending_edits
globals.doc: How many edits are buffered.

globals.name: project_programs
globals.doc: The project's programs (``ProgramInfo``: ``program_id``, ``name``, ``folder_path``).

globals.name: folders
globals.doc: The project's folders (``ProjectFolder``: ``path``, ``folder_id``), parents first.

globals.name: create_folder
globals.doc: Creates the folder at ``path`` ("/libs/json"; with ``parents``, the missing ones above it too) and returns its id; an existing one's id.

globals.name: rename_folder
globals.doc: Renames a folder (its id or path).

globals.name: move_to_folder
globals.doc: Moves programs (ids) and folders (ids or paths) into ``folder`` ("/" the root).

globals.name: delete_folder
globals.doc: Deletes an empty folder.

globals.name: export_project
globals.doc: Writes a .rkproj archive of the project (or of ``programs`` and ``folders``) to ``path``; returns its ``ExportSummary``.

globals.name: open_filesystem
globals.signature: open_filesystem(*, host_path='', program_id='', file=None, project='', limits=None)
globals.doc: Opens a container as a ``FileSystem`` (``list``, ``entries``, ``walk``, ``read``, ``info``, ``extract``, ``close``; use it with ``with``): a program's stored file (``program_id``; default the current program's when nothing else is named), a file or directory on the daemon's host (``host_path``) or local bytes or a path (``file``).

globals.name: import_from_filesystem
globals.doc: Imports files from an open ``FileSystem`` as programs, with the run's provenance; ``options`` are ``FileSystem.import_``'s (``recursive``, ``descend``, ``programs_only``, ``detect_raw``, ``preview``, ``max_programs``, ``folder``, ``keep_folders``, ``analyze``).

globals.name: fid_matches
globals.doc: Function ID's matches on the current program (docs/fid.md): each with ``entry``, ``name`` (what Function ID names it), ``status`` and ``candidates``.

globals.name: run_fid
globals.doc: Runs Function ID on the current program again and returns its matches.

globals.name: apply_fid
globals.doc: Names a function as one of its Function ID candidates (default the proposed name). Not buffered: it commits at once.

globals.name: reject_fid
globals.doc: Rejects a function's Function ID match (its name goes, later runs leave it). Not buffered: it commits at once.

Program.name: at

Program.name: auto_fill_structure

Program.name: bsim_search
Program.doc: Functions similar to this program's in a BSim database (``Client.bsim_search``); no ``functions`` searches them all.

Program.doc: The byte viewer's read (api_minor 44, feature "byte-viewer"): up to 64 KiB from ``addr`` as patched (zeros where there is no memory), ``runs`` saying what the listing makes of the bytes (a run per instruction or data item, undefined and uninitialized coalesced) and ``patched`` with the file's bytes where a patch changed them.

Program.name: clear_equate

Client.doc: Creates a database and attaches it to the project: ``path`` (a new directory on the daemon's host; admin) or, without one, ``bsim/<name>.rkbsim`` in the project's directory. ``template`` "64", "32" or "nosize" (programs of different pointer sizes).

Client.name: create_fid_database
Client.signature: create_fid_database(path, program_ids, family, *, version='', variant='', common_symbols=(), attach=None, project_id='default', actor=None, reason='')
Client.doc: Writes a .rkfid database at ``path`` (on the daemon's host) from programs of the project that have symbols: one library ``family``/``version``/``variant``. ``attach`` ("user" or "project") attaches it too. Needs the admin role.

Client.name: create_folder
Client.doc: Creates a folder in ``parent`` (an id or a path; default the root). ``name`` may also be a whole path ("/a/b"): its parents must exist.

Client.name: debug_session
Client.doc: An existing debug session by id.

Client.name: debug_sessions
Client.doc: The debug sessions of ``client`` (default: this connection).

Client.name: debuginfod_suggestions
Client.doc: The servers the daemon's DEBUGINFOD_URLS names: a suggestion, never used unless set with ``set_debug_file_settings(urls=...)``.

Client.name: delete_folder
Client.doc: Deletes an empty folder (no subfolders, no listed programs).

Client.name: delete_program
Client.doc: Deletes a program softly (feature ``program-management``): hidden from ``programs()``, its data kept; ``restore_program`` brings it back.

Client.name: detach_bsim_database
Client.doc: Detaches a database from the project; its files stay.

Client.name: detach_fid_database
Client.doc: Detaches a database (its ``id``: a path, or ``builtin:<name>``) for the caller or the project.

Client.name: detect_raw_layout
Client.signature: detect_raw_layout(project_id, *, path='', content=b'', language_id='', processor='', progress=None, cancel=None, poll=0.25, timeout=600.0)
Client.doc: For a file with no header (raw firmware, a dump): what a raw import of it needs, detected from its bytes (api_minor 23, feature "raw-detect"). Nothing is imported. Needs what importing needs.

Client.name: diff
Client.signature: diff(project_id, program_a, program_b, *, name='', run=True, wait=True, timeout=600.0, similarity_tiers=(), actor=None)
Client.doc: Creates a diff session of ``program_a`` (the analysed one) against ``program_b`` and, with ``run``, computes its matches (waiting with ``wait``).

Client.name: diff_session
Client.doc: An existing diff session by id.

Client.name: diff_sessions
Client.doc: The project's diff sessions, newest first (those with ``program_id`` on either side).

Client.name: emulator_session
Client.doc: An existing session by id (from :meth:`emulator_sessions` or another client).

Client.name: emulator_sessions
Client.doc: The emulation sessions of ``client`` (default: this connection).

Client.name: export_project
Client.signature: export_project(project_id, path=None, *, programs=(), folders=(), annotations_only=False, host_path='', timeout=None)
Client.doc: Exports a project (or ``programs`` and every program under ``folders``, ids or paths) as a .rkproj archive. With ``path`` the archive is written there and its ``ExportSummary`` returned; without, ``(summary, bytes)``. ``host_path`` makes the daemon write it on its own host instead (admin). ``annotations_only`` leaves the programs' files out (they are found again by sha256 on import).

Client.name: fid_databases
Client.doc: Function ID's databases: Ghidra's shipped ones (``scope`` BUILTIN), the caller's (USER) and the project's (PROJECT), with ``attached``, their libraries and function counts.

Client.name: filesystems
Client.doc: The caller's open file system sessions (an admin's: everyone's).

Client.name: folder_id
Client.doc: A folder's id from its path (or its id, returned as is); "" for the root. ``create`` makes the missing folders along the path.

Client.name: folders
Client.doc: Every folder of a project, parents first (``path``, ``folder_id``, ``parent_id``).

Client.name: import_program
Client.signature: import_program(project_id, *, path='', content=b'', name='', analyze=True, language_id='', image_base=None, format='', progress=None, poll=0.25, raw_offset=0, regions=(), options=None, import_libraries=False, library_search_paths=(), library_depth=0, library_root='', folder_id='')
Client.doc: Imports a file. ``format`` forces "elf", "pe" or a loader plugin by name; by default the built-in loaders are tried, then loader plugins by magic.

Client.name: import_project
Client.signature: import_project(archive, *, into='', name='', folder='', binaries=(), search_dir='', skip_missing=False, inspect=False, on_host=False, timeout=None)
Client.doc: Imports a .rkproj: into a new project (``name``, default the archive's) or ``into`` an existing one as new programs, under ``folder`` (an id or path there). An annotations-only archive's binaries come from ``binaries`` (local files or bytes, uploaded and matched by sha256), programs already in ``into``, and ``search_dir`` on the daemon's host. ``inspect`` only describes the archive and which bina…

Client.name: libraries
Client.doc: A program's shared libraries (api_minor 70, feature ``program-libraries``): each needed library (``name``, the ``program_id`` it resolves to, ``resolution``: LINKED, NAME, SONAME or NONE, ``imports_resolved``), its own first, then theirs; with ``include_imports``, every import and the library function it goes to.

Client.name: library_importers
Client.doc: References back from a library (api_minor 81, feature ``library-importers``): the project's programs whose imports resolve to ``program_id``, each import that does (``importers[].resolved``: its name, thunk and slot in the importer, the function's ``address`` here), and with ``include_references`` the importer's references to it (``importers[].references``, at most ``max_references`` each, defaul…

Client.name: link_library
Client.doc: Says which project program a library ``program_id`` needs is (an assertion: retract ``response.assertion.seq`` to undo); an empty target finds it by name again.

Client.name: list_scripts
Client.doc: The daemon's script libraries (shipped, per-user and, with ``project_id``, the project's) with their metadata; ``host_enabled`` says whether it runs scripts for this caller.

Client.name: login
Client.doc: Logs in (AuthService.Login) and returns a client using the session token. Takes Client's keyword arguments (TLS options, actor, ...).

Client.name: logout
Client.doc: Ends this client's session (a Login token); API tokens are revoked by an admin.

Client.name: move_to_folder
Client.doc: Moves programs (by id) and folders (ids or paths) into ``folder`` in one revision; ``undo_project_edit(project_id, [a.seq for a in resp.assertions])`` undoes it.

Client.name: open_filesystem
Client.signature: open_filesystem(project_id, *, host_path='', program_id='', file=None, name='', limits=None)
Client.doc: Opens a container as a file system (api_minor 48, feature "filesystems"; docs/filesystems.md): an archive, a compressed file, a file system image or a firmware package, nested to any depth.

Client.name: plugins
Client.doc: Every plugin the daemon found: loaded ones, and rejected ones with their error.

Client.name: port_function_markup
Client.signature: port_function_markup(from_program, from_entry, to_program, to_entry, *, items=(), overwrite=False, dry_run=False, project_id='', session_id='', actor=None, reason='')
Client.doc: Ports the name, signature, variables' names and types and comments from one function to another (``items``: "name", "signature", "variable_names", "variable_types", "comments", or ("variable_name", storage_key) for one; empty: everything someone set). One revision; retracting ``seqs`` undoes it (api_minor 54).

Client.name: rename_program
Client.doc: Gives a program a new display name (feature ``program-management``); retract ``response.assertion.seq`` to undo it. An empty name restores the imported one.

Client.name: resolve_import
Client.doc: Where an import goes, by its name or its thunk's or slot's address: the library (``library``), its program (``program_id``), the function's ``address`` there and its ``function_name``; ``resolved`` is False when no library program exports it.

Client.name: restore_program
Client.doc: Undoes a DeleteProgram by retracting the deletion.

Client.name: run_script
Client.signature: run_script(script_id, program_id, *, args=None, address=None, selection=None, confirm_sha256='', reason='', timeout=None)
Client.doc: Starts a script on the daemon (``"shipped/batch_decompile.py"``, ``"user/x.py"``, ``"project/default/x.py"``). Iterate the returned :class:`ScriptRun` for its events (output, progress, prompts) and answer prompts with ``run.answer``; or call ``run.wait()``. ``args`` fill the script's ``args`` and answer prompts of those names.

Client.name: save_script
Client.doc: Writes a per-user script (or the project's, with ``project_id``); ``expected_sha256`` is the hash last read, to replace one.

Client.name: script_runs
Client.doc: Recent runs (this caller's; an admin's: everyone's), newest first.

Client.name: script_source
Client.doc: A script's metadata and source (``.script``, ``.source``).

Client.name: set_debug_file_settings
Client.signature: set_debug_file_settings(*, dirs=None, debuginfod=None, urls=None, allow_http=None, max_bytes=None, cache_max_bytes=None)
Client.doc: Where ELF debug files are looked for and fetched (api_minor 86, feature ``debug-files``; ``SetSymbolSettings``, an admin's): ``dirs`` searched as /usr/lib/debug is (build ID and debuglink), ``debuginfod`` (contact the servers: network access, off by default), ``urls`` (https unless ``allow_http``), the largest file and the cache's size. What is left out (None) stays as it is; the symbol path too.

Client.name: set_symbol_settings
Client.doc: Sets the daemon's symbol path (``SetSymbolSettings``; an admin's). ``downloads`` lets it contact the servers the path names: network access on the daemon's host (docs/security.md). The debug file settings (``set_debug_file_settings``) stay as they are.

Client.name: setup_script_python
Client.doc: Makes the Python environment the daemon runs scripts with (``~/.local/share/revkit/pyenv`` on the daemon's machine, as ``rk-script setup`` does) when ``list_scripts().python_problem`` says there is none (api_minor 33, feature "scripts-setup"). ``output`` gets what the steps print as it comes; the result has ``ok``, ``python`` and ``error``.

Client.name: stubs
Client.doc: The raw generated stubs, for anything the wrapper does not cover.

Client.name: subscribe
Client.doc: Opens a change stream; returns once the server's Hello arrived.

Client.name: symbol_settings
Client.doc: Where Load PDB looks PDBs up (``GetSymbolSettings``; an admin's): ``symbol_path`` (_NT_SYMBOL_PATH syntax), ``downloads`` (symbol servers may be contacted), ``cache_dir``.

Client.name: undo_project_edit
Client.doc: Retracts ops of a project by seq: folder edits, or any of its programs' (api_minor 37).

Client.name: update_bsim_executable
Client.doc: Renames an executable or replaces its categories (when ``categories`` is given).

Client.name: upload
Client.doc: Sends a local file (or bytes) to the daemon in pieces (UploadChunk); returns the upload id ImportProjectArchive takes (``archive`` or a binary). Uploads lapse an hour after their last piece.

Client.name: whoami
Client.doc: Who the daemon takes this client for (``auth_enabled`` false: --no-auth).

Monitor.name: checkCancelled
Monitor.doc: Raises :class:`Cancelled` when the run was cancelled.

Monitor.name: check_cancelled
Monitor.doc: Raises :class:`Cancelled` when the run was cancelled.

Function.name: thunk
Function.doc: A thunk (a jump to another function).

GhidraProgram.name: getRelocationTable
GhidraProgram.doc: The relocations the file carries (feature relocation-table).

GhidraAddress.name: subtract
GhidraAddress.doc: ``Address - long`` is an Address; ``Address - Address`` is a long.

GhidraAddress.name: subtractNoWrap
GhidraAddress.doc: ``Address - long`` is an Address; ``Address - Address`` is a long.

GhidraAddress.name: subtractWrap
GhidraAddress.doc: ``Address - long`` is an Address; ``Address - Address`` is a long.
